findings.evidence: Statement at MaximalSubfield.lean:190-193 is `(L : Subalgebra K D) [IsMulCommutative ↥L] [FiniteDimensional K ↥L] : IsField ↥L` under `variable ... [IsDomain D]` (line 185). Mathlib names this hypothesis even though it is an instance: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Artinian/Module.lean:536 lemma isField_of_isDomain [IsDomain R] : IsField R`, and `Mathlib/RingTheory/KrullDimension/Zero.lean:56 Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isDomain`.
findings.fix: Name the hypothesis that does the work: `isField_of_isMulCommutative_of_isDomain`, or move it into the `Subalgebra` namespace (the repo already does this in e.g. `TauCeti/RingTheory/Ideal/SubringSpan.lean` `namespace Submodule`) with the `_of_isDomain` suffix retained.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.isField_of_isMulCommutative` names only the commutativity hypothesis; the content comes from the ambient `[IsDomain D]` (plus finiteness). At `TauCeti` root the name asserts, on its face, that a commutative subalgebra is a field, which is false without the domain hypothesis.

findings.evidence: Centralizer.lean:293 `[IsSimpleRing (↥B ⊗[K] Aᵐᵒᵖ)]`; TauCeti/Algebra/CentralSimple/TensorProduct.lean:325 supplies `IsSimpleRing (L ⊗[K] A)`; the `mulOpposite` suffix is already the local convention in TauCeti/Algebra/CentralSimple/Degree.lean:201 `finrank_tensorProduct_mulOpposite` and :217 `deg_tensorProduct_mulOpposite`, both for `A ⊗[K] Aᵐᵒᵖ`.
findings.fix: Rename to `finrank_mul_finrank_centralizer_of_isSimpleRing_tensorProduct_mulOpposite`, matching the repo's own convention for naming an `Aᵐᵒᵖ` factor.
findings.issue: `finrank_mul_finrank_centralizer_of_isSimpleRing_tensorProduct` does not say which tensor product is assumed simple. Both orientations are live in this repo — the hypothesis here is `IsSimpleRing (↥B ⊗[K] Aᵐᵒᵖ)` (line 293), while `IsSimpleRing (L ⊗[K] A)` is what `TauCeti/Algebra/CentralSimple/Subfield.lean` runs on — so the name is ambiguous exactly where it needs to discriminate.

summary: Two new names omit the hypothesis that actually does the work: `isField_of_isMulCommutative` reads as "commutative ⟹ field" with no mention of the ambient domain, and `..._of_isSimpleRing_tensorProduct` does not say which of the two live tensor products must be simple. Everything else follows the conventions and the adjacent declarations.
